title: tc-text-to-speech
description:
Reads a passage aloud – the sentence and word being spoken marked in the text, with play, pause, stop, sentence
skips, a voice picker, speed and pitch.

description.description: A quiet line under the heading – the source or what the passage is

text.description: The passage to read: plain text; a blank line starts a new paragraph

rate.description: Speaking speed from 0.5 to 2 (1 is normal). Changed by the element unless a tc-rate-change listener calls preventDefault()

pitch.description: Pitch from 0 to 2 (1 is normal). Changed by the element unless a tc-pitch-change listener calls preventDefault()

voice.description: The chosen voice's `voiceURI`, or "" for the browser's default. Changed unless a tc-voice-change listener calls preventDefault()

lang.description: The passage's language (a BCP 47 tag) – picks a default voice and splits sentences; unset, the browser decides. Reflects to the lang attribute, as HTMLElement's own does, so assistive tech and fonts see it
